# TaiwanWay 臺灣味

> Authentic Taiwanese restaurant and café at 26 South St, Middletown, NY 10940, serving Orange County and the Hudson Valley region. Specializing in Taiwanese comfort food, handmade desserts, and authentic Taiwan-imported bubble tea with Kyoto matcha.

## Signature Dishes

- **Braised Beef Noodle Soup (紅燒牛肉麵)** — Regular $14.85 / Large $16.85 — Taiwanese braised beef noodle soup with slow-cooked beef brisket, rich spiced soy broth, springy noodles
- **Sesame Beef Noodles (麻醬牛肉乾麵)** — Regular $14.85 / Large $16.85 — Chewy noodles tossed in rich sesame paste, topped with braised beef shank and seasonal greens
- **Braised Pork Rice (滷肉飯)** — Regular $11.45 / Large $13.45 — Traditional minced pork belly braised in soy, sugar, and five-spice over steaming rice
- **Chiayi Chicken Rice (嘉義雞肉飯)** — Regular $11.45 / Large $13.45 — Hand-shredded chicken breast over fluffy rice with golden fried shallots and signature sauce
- **Sakura Shrimp Sticky Rice (櫻花蝦米糕)** — $13.45 — Taiwanese sticky rice steamed with sakura shrimp, dried shiitake, and fried shallots

## Drinks (Bubble Tea & Tea)

Tea leaves imported directly from Taiwan. Fresh milk (no powder). Tapioca pearls cooked fresh daily. Sugar and ice levels customizable.

- **Bubble Tea:** Taiwanese Bubble Tea 招牌珍珠奶茶 ($6.85), Brown Sugar Bubble Milk 黑糖珍珠鮮奶 ($6.85), Jasmine Green Bubble Tea 茉莉珍珠綠奶茶 ($6.85), Honey Oolong Bubble Tea 蜜香烏龍珍珠奶茶 ($6.85)
- **Milk Tea:** Taiwanese Milk Tea 台灣蜜香奶茶 ($6.25), Jasmine Green Milk Tea 茉莉綠奶茶 ($6.25), Honey Oolong Milk Tea 蜂蜜烏龍奶茶 ($6.25)
- **Green Tea:** Honey Jasmine Green Tea 蜂蜜綠茶 ($5.25)
- **Ippodo Matcha (Kyoto, Japan):** Matcha Latte 抹茶拿鐵 ($6.25)
- **Pot-Brewed Taiwan Loose-Leaf Tea (sugar-free):** Dong Pian 冬片 ($5), Spring Tea 春茶 ($5), Jin Xuan 金萱 ($5), Tieguanyin 鐵觀音 ($6), Alishan Black Tea 阿里山紅茶 ($5)
- **Lemonade:** Winter Melon Lemonade 冬瓜檸檬 ($6.25)
- **Combo add-on:** Bubble tea ($5.00)

## Desserts

- **Taiwan Pineapple Cake (台灣鳳梨酥)** — $3.25 — Handmade daily with traditional buttery pastry and sweet Taiwan pineapple filling. Single or gift box available.
- **Mango Coconut Pannacotta (芒果椰奶奶酪)** — $4.85 — Italian pannacotta with coconut milk and fresh mango cubes

## What Makes TaiwanWay Distinctive

1. **Authentic Taiwanese sourcing** — All tea leaves imported directly from Taiwan; matcha from Ippodo (one-hundred-year-old tea house in Kyoto, Japan)
2. **Fresh preparation daily** — Tapioca pearls cooked every morning, pineapple cakes handmade on-site, no powdered milk or syrups
3. **Family recipes** — Beef noodle soup and braised pork rice follow owner's Taiwanese family tradition
4. **Trilingual operation** — Rare in the Hudson Valley; website, menu, staff all serve English, Chinese, and Spanish speakers
5. **Hudson Valley / Orange County exclusive** — The only authentic Taiwanese café of this scale in Middletown NY and surrounding Orange County
